content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela often face barriers with traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. These restrictions limit your ability to monetize digital products effectively. COREMERCH offers a robust solution through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-4|Cloudflare R2]]-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-7|cloudflare]] Pages, enabling you to establish a fully functional crypto store without relying on conventional payment systems. This guide will walk you through the process, empowering you to take control and build an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-6|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that works for you.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure is built on the premise of sovereignty. When platforms fail or impose restrictions, you are still in control. By using Cloudflare Pages, you tap into a global CDN that ensures your digital store is accessible and fast. The integration of NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture is not just resilient; it is designed to empower creators by removing dependencies on platforms that may not support them.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you'll need a few essential components: a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account for hosting, and a NOWPayments account for processing crypto payments. Additionally, prepare your digital products for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint to streamline the deployment process. Ensure you have access to a domain or subdomain where your store will be hosted. With these elements in place, you will be ready to build your store efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store. Once set up, implement Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic seamlessly. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment processing, ensuring that every transaction is secure and verified. After that, establish a file delivery system using Supabase or Google Drive, allowing customers immediate access to purchased products. This pipeline guarantees that your customers receive their digital products instantly after payment.
Own your infrastructure without relying on restrictive platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your store set up, it's time to go live. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages application and ensure all components are functioning correctly. Conduct a test transaction using NOWPayments to verify that everything works as intended. Check your order management setup to confirm that all data is recorded accurately. Once you've processed your first transaction successfully, promote your store through social media or direct outreach to attract your initial customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your store, focus on scaling your operations. Consider expanding your product offerings by adding more digital products, utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced features. Enhance customer engagement through email marketing and by optimizing your store's SEO. Regularly analyze your sales metrics to identify trends and opportunities for growth. The infrastructure you've built allows for easy scaling, ensuring you can adapt to increased demand without worrying about platform limitations.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploy your crypto store in just 48 hours with the right stack.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account and set up your domain. Open a GitHub account to host your store. Register for a NOWPayments account to process crypto payments. Prepare your digital products for upload. Configure Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Implement Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Set up Supabase or Google Drive for product delivery. Test your integrations and go live with your store. Promote your store to reach potential customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a digital store with crypto payments?

Start by creating accounts on Cloudflare, GitHub, and NOWPayments. Then, follow the Sovereign Blueprint for deployment, integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. Ensure your digital products are ready for delivery through Cloudflare Pages.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, allowing deployment in 4-6 hours. Stack 02, however, employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust solution deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. They provide the necessary infrastructure for hosting your store and handling transactions efficiently.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This flexibility allows you to cater to a wide range of customers without the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, both Stack 01 and Stack 02 include 30 days of support after deployment, ensuring you have assistance as you establish your store and address any initial challenges.
